title: Lambda Response Streaming via API Gateway — Countdown Timer (.NET)
description: Stream a countdown timer from Lambda through API Gateway response streaming, demonstrating time-to-first-byte and long-running streamed responses.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern deploys a Lambda function that streams a countdown timer through an API Gateway REST API. The client receives the first line immediately, then subsequent countdown ticks arrive every N seconds.
API Gateway is configured with ResponseTransferMode: STREAM and the Lambda uses the /response-streaming-invocations URI path. The countdown can run for up to 10 minutes while streaming progress.
This is the simplest possible response streaming pattern — no external dependencies, just a timer demonstrating TTFB improvement and the .NET response streaming SDK.
See the GitHub repo for detailed testing instructions.
